title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
summary: Just 9 months after raising a $180 million seed round, Flapping Airplanes has landed a $1 billion Series A for its mission to build AI models "without ingesting half the internet."

title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at $8.8B valuation
summary: Legal AI startup Legora announced Wednesday that it raised a $550 million Series E round, valuing it at $8.8 billion.

title: Blacksmith hits unicorn valuation after Sequoia leads Series C
summary: Blacksmith, a platform that lets companies build and test AI code more effectively, just announced a $66 million Series C round led by Sequoia that values the company at $1 billion.

title: Mach9 raises $34M after pivoting to AI CAD software
summary: The startup initially set out to build better, faster, and cheaper surveying hardware in 2021.

title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
summary: Eric Schmidt’s fortune is about to get even bigger.

title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
summary: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

title: Khosla Ventures doubles down on Even Healthcare to challenge India’s hospital economics
summary: Even Healthcare reaches a $300 million valuation in a Khosla Ventures-led round as it plans to expand its hospital network in India.

title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character AI’s workforce
summary: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.

title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt.  This view runs counter to those who believe that robotics, powered by a general foundation model, is about to have […]

title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists
summary: Tressfecta builds products for textured hair. Its first project is a tool called Plait Pilot that helps braiders with the initial process of separating hair from packs before braiding begins.

title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
summary: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.

title: And the winner of Startup Battlefield at Disrupt 2026 is: Intero Biosystems
summary: Intero Biosystems beat out 199 other Startup Battlefield companies to take home the $100,000 grand prize at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

title: Last chance to save up to $200 on your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass: Early booking ends October 16
summary: Savings of up to $200 end October 16 for TechCrunch Founder Summit. These savings for Founder and Investor Passes vanish after Friday. Join 1,000 founders and investors on November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station. Bring your toughest questions and make the day count for your business.

title: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
summary: The funding comes as Ramp's annualized revenue crosses $2B, and its customer count reaches 85,000.
